262.text: the fair young man who looked like a boy

532.text: The first man who came in

quotes.text:
"I will not let you
stay.  Send my Ayah to me."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "Is it so very bad? Oh, is it?"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"Awfully, Mrs.
Lennox.  You ought to have gone to the hills two weeks ago."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"I only stayed to go to that silly
dinner party.  What a fool I was!"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"You did not say it had
broken out among your servants."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"It sounds as if there were no
one in the bungalow but me and the snake."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"That pretty, pretty woman!  I
suppose the child, too.  I heard there was a child, though no one ever
saw her."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"There is a child here! A child alone! In a
place like this! Mercy on us, who is she!"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"I fell asleep when everyone had the cholera and I
have only just wakened up.  Why does nobody come?"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "It is the child no one ever saw!"
quotes.speaker: Unknown
